notes: New base: Ali Al Salem Air Base, west of Al Jahra, at its real location. Its airfield comes from OpenStreetMap: both 2,990 m runways (12L/30R and 12R/30L) with overruns, the taxiways, aprons, hardened aircraft shelters, hangars and helipads, in the map and in 3D. Squadrons you base there park on its ramps

Ali Al Salem is the theater air base: strike fighters, A-10s, gunships, tankers, airlift, UAVs and helicopters fly from it, and it also takes engineers, MPs, medical, logistics, intelligence and air defense. Combat formations still come in through Camp Doha
Camp Doha is now the administrative receiving base for troops arriving in theater; it no longer takes fixed-wing aircraft. Aircraft already at Doha in a saved campaign move to Ali Al Salem
